title: papaver dubium var. hirtellum
intro: Papaver dubium var. hirtellum, commonly known as the rough poppy, is a variety of the poppy plant that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which can help to relieve pain and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Papaver dubium var. hirtellum include alkaloids such as papaverine, which has been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions, including vasodilation and spasmolytic effects. However, it is essential to note that while Papaver dubium var. hirtellum may have medicinal properties, its use should be approached with caution due to potential toxicity and side effects.
